label: Mentoring
title: I mentor founders for accelerators and startup programs.
intro: Most weeks I end up in a room with founders who are three months from running out of patience or money. I am useful in that room: go to market, corporate sales, fundraising narrative, and the unglamorous question of what to cut.
imageAlt: Max Bender running a session with founders around a table

items.title: Accelerator mentoring
items.body: Office hours and review sessions for cohorts, usually pre-seed to Series A.

items.title: Selection and jury
items.body: Screening applications and sitting on selection panels without wasting anyone's afternoon.

items.title: Workshops
items.body: Working sessions on corporate sales, pilots and how to not die inside a procurement process.

cta: If you run a program and need a mentor, email me.
